verdict.summary: Frozen vegetables are generally safe, but there can be gluten risks due to cross-contamination or added sauces. It's important to check for any gluten-containing ingredients in the packaging.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
